description: Rank up to 5 products by stated criteria, never by commission. Inputs: product_ids (1–5), region (EU or US), optional criteria (price_per_serving, third_party_testing, dose, protein_per_serving). Returns rows with price, price per serving, third-party testing, label dose and caffeine, plus a plain store URL for the top-ranked product (affiliate params only after approval). Read-only.
name: compare
title: Compare products
